title: Why Most Plastic Never Actually Gets Recycled
hook: Only a sliver of the plastic you recycle actually becomes something new.
closing: Labels promise recycle; landfills prove otherwise.
question: How much actually recycles? Comment below.

segments.say: Plastic waste will rise from 353 million to over a billion tons by 2060.
Only 9 percent of plastic actually gets recycled -- most of the rest piles up in landfills.
Even the best-case forecast from experts has recycling reaching just 17 percent by 2060.
